title: Action Sheet (Konsta UI, iOS + Material)
notes:
Konsta UI Action Sheet example: mobile components made with Tailwind CSS that follow iOS and Material Design (Android) look and feel.

Use: npm i konsta (React, Vue or Svelte). Docs: https://konstaui.com

Original file: https://github.com/konstaui/konsta/blob/master/kitchen-sink/react/pages/ActionSheet.jsx
code:

Action Sheet is a slide-up pane for presenting the user with a set of alternatives for how to proceed with a given task.
